panels.title: Endpoints (method + URI)
panels.description: Reqs = total calls in the selected range. RPM = average requests per minute over that same range.

targets.expr: round(sum by (method, uri) (increase(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range]))) > 0

(sum by (method, uri) (increase(inventory_http_duration_seconds_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range])) / sum by (method, uri) (increase(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range]))) and (sum by (method, uri) (increase(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, uri) (increase(inventory_http_latency_bucket_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range]))) and (sum by (method, uri) (increase(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, method, uri) (increase(inventory_http_latency_bucket_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range]))) and (sum by (method, uri) (increase(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range])) > 0)

((sum by (method, uri) (increase(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS", status=~"[45].."}[$__range])) or (sum by (method, uri) (increase(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range])) * 0)) / sum by (method, uri) (increase(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range]))) and (sum by (method, uri) (increase(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range])) > 0)

(sum by (method, uri) (rate(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range])) * 60) and (sum by (method, uri) (increase(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: RPM by route
panels.description: Average requests per minute (trailing 5 minutes). A spike of 12 requests in 5 min shows as 2.4 RPM.

targets.expr: sum by (method, uri) (rate(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS"}[5m])) * 60
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, uri) (increase(inventory_http_latency_bucket_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", method!="OPTIONS"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, method, uri) (increase(inventory_http_latency_bucket_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", method!="OPTIONS"}[5m])))
sum by (method, uri, status) (increase(inventory_api_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", uri=~".+", method!="OPTIONS", status=~"[45].."}[5m]))

panels.title: Searches / 5 min by surface and outcome
panels.description: How many searches ran and how they ended. ok = answered; timeout = hit the 3 s limit; regex_rejected = unsafe regular expression refused; validation_error = bad request; error = unexpected failure.

targets.expr: sum by (surface, outcome) (increase(inventory_product_search_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module"}[5m]))

panels.title: Search latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Wall time of a search end to end (validate, query, load the page, enrich). Target: p95 under 300 ms.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (increase(inventory_product_search_latency_bucket_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(inventory_product_search_latency_bucket_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (increase(inventory_product_search_latency_bucket_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module"}[5m])))

panels.title: Average time per search: total vs database
panels.description: If the two lines are far apart the time is going into enrichment (pricing, vertical fields), not the query.

targets.expr: sum by (surface) (increase(inventory_product_search_duration_ms_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module"}[5m])) / sum by (surface) (increase(inventory_product_search_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", outcome="ok"}[5m]))

sum by (surface) (increase(inventory_product_search_db_ms_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module"}[5m])) / sum by (surface) (increase(inventory_product_search_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", outcome="ok"}[5m]))

panels.title: Average matches per search
panels.description: How broad searches are. Very high numbers mean people are browsing the whole shop; the planner handles that, but it is useful context for latency.

targets.expr: sum by (surface) (increase(inventory_product_search_matched_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module"}[5m])) / sum by (surface) (increase(inventory_product_search_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", outcome="ok"}[5m]))

panels.title: Facets requested / 5 min
panels.description: Which filter groups people have open. Each facet is one extra counting branch in the query.

targets.expr: sum by (facet) (increase(inventory_product_search_facets_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module"}[5m]))

panels.title: Slow searches, timeouts and rejections / 5 min
panels.description: Slow searches also write a WARN line with the request shape (fields and operators, never values). Suggested alerts: p95 > 1 s for 10 min; more than 5 timeouts in 5 min.

targets.expr: sum by (surface) (increase(inventory_product_search_slow_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module"}[5m]))
sum by (outcome) (increase(inventory_product_search_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", outcome=~"timeout|regex_rejected|error"}[5m]))

panels.title: How people search: text vs filters
panels.description: text = whether the search box was used; filters = how many filter groups (0, 1, 2-3, 4+); mode = pattern or regex.

targets.expr: sum by (text, filters, mode) (increase(inventory_product_search_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module", outcome="ok"}[5m]))
sum by (operation, outcome, channel, provider, vertical) (rate({__name__="$metric", service="inventory-api", env="$env", module="$module"}[5m]))

panels.title: Attendance app punches per result
panels.description: One increment per punch attempt, one result label each (R10.1–R10.2): accepted, flagged, duplicate, replayed, off, not_paired, not_employed, on_leave, locked, outside_shop, location_unclear, fake_location, offline_accepted, offline_too_late, offline_clock_wrong, signature_failed, rate_limited, invalid, error. signature_failed above 1 % of a shop's attempts points to a tampered app or a broken phone key. The dashed series is the R10.4 signature failure rate per shop (signature_failed ÷ all attempts over a rolling 1 h window, right axis); the red line is the 1 % alert threshold of AppPunchHealthService, which also needs ≥ 20 attempts in the window before it raises an alert. Metric rows: [docs/metrics.md → hr](https://github.com/Stockkart/inventory-api/blob/main/docs/metrics.md#hr).

targets.expr: sum by (result) (rate(inventory_hr_app_punches_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", shop=~"$shop"}[5m]))

(sum by (shop) (rate(inventory_hr_app_punches_total{result="signature_failed", service="inventory-api", env="$env", shop=~"$shop"}[1h])) or sum by (shop) (rate(inventory_hr_app_punches_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", shop=~"$shop"}[1h])) * 0) / sum by (shop) (rate(inventory_hr_app_punches_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", shop=~"$shop"}[1h]))

panels.title: Attendance app offline backlog
panels.description: Accepted offline punches that reached the server more than 1 hour after their phone time (R10.7b), per hour. A rising line means phones are holding punches for a long time: poor signal in the shop or the app not being opened. The legend is the per-shop table: one row per shop (query B) under the all-shops total (query A), with the latest hour, the worst hour and the mean in the time range; sort by Last to find the shop holding punches now. Metric rows: [docs/metrics.md → hr](https://github.com/Stockkart/inventory-api/blob/main/docs/metrics.md#hr).

targets.expr: sum(increase(inventory_hr_app_offline_backlog_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", shop=~"$shop"}[1h]))
sum by (shop) (increase(inventory_hr_app_offline_backlog_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", shop=~"$shop"}[1h]))

panels.title: Attendance app pairing failures per reason
panels.description: Failed pairing attempts by reason (R2.14, R10.3): code_expired, code_used, code_cancelled, code_wrong, app_off, employee_exited, abandoned, locked. Many code_wrong from one shop means workers are mistyping the 8 characters; locked means the installation lockout or the 11th attempt on one code. Metric rows: [docs/metrics.md → hr](https://github.com/Stockkart/inventory-api/blob/main/docs/metrics.md#hr).

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (rate(inventory_hr_app_pairings_total{event="failed", service="inventory-api", env="$env", shop=~"$shop"}[5m]))

panels.title: Join requests per event
panels.description: Stockkart Team join requests per hour (worker-app R14.2–R14.3), one series per event: created, approved_created, approved_linked, rejected, withdrawn. Over any period created = approved_created + approved_linked + rejected + withdrawn + still pending, so a created line that keeps climbing above the decisions is an inbox nobody is clearing. Metric rows: [docs/metrics.md → hr](https://github.com/Stockkart/inventory-api/blob/main/docs/metrics.md#hr).

targets.expr: sum by (event) (increase(inventory_hr_worker_join_requests_total{service="inventory-api", env="$env", shop=~"$shop"}[1h]))
